title: DOH DEPOSIT BEVERAGE CONTAINER PROGRAM TO UPDATE SEGREGATED RATES
summary: HONOLULU — The Hawaiʻi Department of Health (DOH) Deposit Beverage Container Program is revising its segregated rates, which will take effect on Oct. 1, 2026. Segregated rates are used when redeeming deposit beverage containers by weight, to convert the container weight into an equivalent container count.
